findings.claim: the docs said copier update changes nothing after a release with no template change
the .pre-commit-config.yaml row did not name the agent files the hooks skip

verdict.text: Both doc findings are fixed and the edits add nothing wrong.
My `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: all four gates and eval rows r1, r2, r3, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9 pass.
Read the how-to's "Keep a project current" section and ADR 0025's Consequences: both now say an update after an unchanged release changes only `_commit` in `.copier-answers.yml`.
Compared the how-to's `.pre-commit-config.yaml` row with the `exclude:` in starter/.pre-commit-config.yaml: `.agents/`, `.claude/agents|rules|skills/`, `.opencode/`, `opencode.json`.
The row names the same set.
